source: World Aquatics (FINA) Points Table - Long Course Meters (LCM) 2024 / 2025
formula: Points = floor(1000 * (B / T)^3), where B is base_time_seconds and T is swim_time_seconds
notes: Women's 800m Freestyle base time is 484.79s (8:04.79) for 2024/pre-May 2025; updated to 8:04.12 only after May 2025 WR.
